whatItDoes: Make the described portion of eastern Custer County part of the West Custer County Hospital District. The proposed inclusion area contains real property outside both the current hospital district’s service territory and the Rye Fire Protection District’s service territory. The question lists no conditions for inclusion.
yesMeans: Include the described area in the West Custer County Hospital District.
noMeans: Do not include this area in the hospital district through this question.
